Records (left) → the figures built from them → the front-page section each sits under, read from build_readme.py: the data keys each figure function uses, followed through load() and
stats(). The four task figures share the catalog and tailoring.

Generated by tools/figures/frontpage_readme.py from tools/readme/build_readme.py (read with ast), the figures it writes and README.md. Every number on the front page is read from a record; nothing on it is reviewed or accepted (rule R13).

g.text: Terms: DoD = US Department of Defense · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · R01 … = validator rule in tools/pdac (R13 = only a named human review accepts anything) · US =
